subject: FIFA World Cup Invite - June 22 VIP Lounge
text:

My co-founder [SENDER] <[LINK]>

subject: Data management for complex terrain
text:
Hi [NAME],

Saw the recent announcement & the shift you're experiencing from development to commercial deployment - wanted to reach out as we've been working with a few teams scaling perception systems for autonomous navigation in complex terrain. 

We're mostly assisting with improving model quality / delivery speed while keeping development costs low as they scale through better end-to-end data mgmt and by allowing them to curate/annotate high resolution videos natively. 

Not sure how familiar you are with Encord - data development platform for computer vision and multimodal AI teams, ~5 years old, 70+ people, $110M raised. 

I'd love to get your candid feedback on what we've built. Let me know if you're open for a quick chat Tuesday to Friday next week?

subject: Data labelling solution
text:

Sounds like there are currently some difficulties around model synchronisation (e.g. traffic light transitions & vehicle response behaviour) - happy to demonstrate how Encord's customisable pipelines help strike the right balance between automation and QA.
